title: From Flash games to platform engineering

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Antoine didn't start in Kubernetes. He started in browser tabs, game loops, and a makerspace that smelled like hot PLA.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I love that. So where does the story begin?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Around 2010, in high school, building small browser games in Flash and learning HTML and JavaScript. Progress meant something you could click. Years later he packaged some of that nostalgia as FlashGames, running in the browser.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: By college he was redoing favorites in Unity, CryEngine and Unreal. At Collégial International Sainte-Anne he managed the makerspace, with 3D printers and VR gear, and built a WiFi-controlled RC car. That's also when he got serious about the web.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A five-week internship at Algolux in computational imaging: Python tools, RAW color analysis, Ansible stacks. He sums up the habit it built as measure, automate, document.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Where school projects stacked into a career. A capstone hovercraft with a lift fan and a 3D-printed skirt. A bachelor's from 2018 to 2023, running workshops at AlgoÉTS, the algorithmic trading club. Co-ops at Wandrian, Power Go and Intact, then full-time at IONODES on an IoT cloud platform.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A hovercraft teaches integration before microservices.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Ha, exactly his point. Now he's doing a master's at ÉTS on real-time rendering and surface wear with dynamic friction, which ties graphics back into the path.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Platform, security and teaching. GitLab CI/CD, GCP, Playwright tests, DevSecOps labs at Polytechnique Montréal with GitLab templates for about twenty teams, and teaching distributed databases and mobile labs at ÉTS.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Backend boundaries, platforms with local dev that works, and delivery paths that are boring on purpose. His advice: follow problems where you see the whole loop, code, deploy, operate, improve.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Nice. Where do I find the stories?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The full write-up has the career diagram, photos of the hovercraft and the club workshop, and links to each project.
